§3§lQuest gates§r
Vending-machine entries can require completion of a specified BetterQuesting quest. Unmet conditions keep an entry locked; §cthe gate allows access if BetterQuesting is absent or the query fails§r.

§3§lEntry cooldowns and limits§r
Cooldowns use each player's history for each trade entry. Some bundled entries use §16 / 22 / 88 hours§r; this does not rotate a whole page's stock. Entries with unlimited uses may still have cooldowns. Check the entry display and server settings for the actual limits.

§3§lCompletion§r
Read the unlocking and cooldown rules, then tick the checkbox and view the unlocked entries.
